Standardize Raw PAM Audio Files (Stage 00 Engine)

Source: R/00_standardization.R
pam_standardize.Rd

Standardizes raw audio datasets by organizing folders, parsing timestamps, converting formats (WAV/FLAC), resampling, mixing channels to mono, isolating non-audio/memos, and logging results.

Usage

pam_standardize(
  cfg = NULL,
  raw_dir = NULL,
  standardized_dir = NULL,
  isolated_dir = NULL,
  dry_run = NULL,
  prefix = NULL,
  target_format = NULL,
  target_hz = NULL,
  channels = NULL,
  min_duration_s = NULL,
  organize_folders = NULL,
  rename_strategy = NULL,
  isolate_non_audio = NULL,
  isolate_short = NULL,
  timezone = NULL
)

Arguments

cfg

Optional configuration object from pam_load_config().

raw_dir

Directory containing raw audio files.

standardized_dir

Directory to save standardized audio.

isolated_dir

Directory to save isolated non-audio and memo files.

dry_run

Logical, if TRUE simulates actions without modifying disk.

prefix

Prefix string prepended to standardized filenames.

target_format

Output format: "flac" or "wav".

target_hz

Target sample rate (Hz). If NULL or higher than input, original rate is kept.

channels

Target audio channels (1 = mono, 2 = stereo).

min_duration_s

Minimum duration threshold for valid recordings (default 60s).

organize_folders

Subfolder structure: "grid" (G0059/), "date" (YYYY/MM/DD), "grid_date" (G0059/YYYY/MM/DD), "preserve", or "flat".

rename_strategy

Naming strategy: "auto" (uses extracted datetime) or "keep".

isolate_non_audio

Logical, isolate non-audio files?

isolate_short

Logical, isolate short audio clips?

timezone

Timezone string (default "Asia/Kolkata").

Value

data.table containing audit log of standardization operations.
